name: Yamaha V Star 650
engine: 649 cc air-cooled V-twin, carbs, shaft drive
intro: A simple, common cruiser. Most trouble comes from gummed carbs and the fuel pump.

G: Bogging and backfiring usually trace to the carbs or a weak fuel pump. Check fuel flow before you blame the jets.

recallNote: No recalls found for these years when this course was written. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to be sure.

known.title: Carbs and fuel pump
known.what: Bogging, backfiring and fuel pump faults are common owner complaints.
